title: sessions human table misaligns: PROJECT column not width-capped, --no-truncate breaks the table entirely
description:
**Observed on real data (origin/develop `9fc6584`):** in `botspy sessions` human output the PROJECT column renders values up to 38 chars (the `render::truncate` cap) inside a 20-char `render::column` slot that only pads and never truncates, so long project ids (`-Users-home-Projects-Apricity`, ``…kanbus-opencode-issue-router-417db0`) push the MSGS / LAST ACTIVITY / TITLE columns out of alignment with the header. With `--no-truncate` the full 36-char uuids and full paths are spliced into fixed-width slots, so every column after SESSION is ragged and the table is unreadable.

**Repro:**
1. `./target/release/botspy sessions --limit 5` → PROJECT values overflow their column; header and rows do not line up.
2. `./target/release/botspy sessions --limit 5 --no-truncate` → full ids/paths inserted raw; table completely misaligned.

**Expected:** human tables stay aligned in both modes. In truncated mode each column is capped at its declared width (with a tail-keep ellipsis like `render::truncate`); in `--no-truncate` mode columns widen to fit the longest value (headers still aligned) instead of splicing fixed-width slots. Machine modes are untouched (they never truncate).

**Suspected code:** `src/cli/mod.rs` `fn sessions_human()` (~line 391-434) and `src/cli/render.rs` — `render::column()` pads but never truncates; `render::truncate()` caps at `TRUNCATE_WIDTH = 38`, wider than the PROJECT column's 20.

**Note (folded in, not this fix's scope):** `botspy show` elides each message's parts to a single fragment (`· text  …organization without using Tailscale?` — one line, tail-kept, no length control). Acceptable for a walk-the-messages view, but the elision is undocumented and there is no flag to widen it; worth its own story under the CLI epic BOTSPY-7c2705.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Regression scenario on the synthetic fixture home: human `sessions` output has every data row aligned with the header column starts, in both default and `--no-truncate` modes (e.g. assert MSGS/LAST ACTIVITY column positions are identical on header and rows).
- PROJECT values longer than the column are tail-kept with the ellipsis marker in truncated mode and shown in full in `--no-truncate` mode without breaking alignment.
- Machine modes unchanged; existing scenarios (`stdout reports`, id truncation footer) stay green.
- Note: `botspy sources`, `botspy doctor` and `botspy show` already work correctly on real data.
